source.title: Score sheets were used as cube covers in some events of a competition
source.content:
At Hanoi Open 2022, score sheets were used instead of appropriate cube covers for certain events (Clock, Pyraminx, and Megaminx) in violation of Regulation A2c1:

> [A2c1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A2c1)) The scrambler places a cover over the scrambled puzzle that makes it impossible for any competitors or spectators to see any part of the puzzle. The cover remains over the puzzle until the start of the attempt.

Guideline A2c1+ also explicitly prohibits the use of score sheets as covers:

> [A2c1+](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html#A2c1+)) REMINDER In the past, score sheets have been used to cover puzzles while leaving some sides exposed. This is no longer permitted.

Although there is no evidence that anyone actively tried to cheat, the WRC agreed that this is a serious violation of scramble secrecy, therefore **all the results from Clock, Pyraminx, and Megaminx had been removed**. This decision also follows the precedent from Cavite Open 2 2018 (see this [incident log](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/31)).

translation.title: 比赛部分项目使用成绩单遮盖魔方
translation.content:
Hanoi Open 2022 的魔表、金字塔和五魔方用成绩单替代合适的魔方罩，违反 A2c1：
> [A2c1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A2c1) 打乱员须遮盖打乱后的魔方，使任何选手或观众都无法看见任何部分，并保持遮盖至尝试开始。

A2c1+ 也明确禁止此做法：
> [A2c1+](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html#A2c1+) 提醒：过去曾用成绩单遮盖魔方，却仍暴露部分侧面。这种做法现已禁止。

虽然没有证据表明任何人主动试图作弊，WRC 认为这严重违反打乱保密要求，因此**删除了魔表、金字塔和五魔方的全部成绩**。此决定也遵循 Cavite Open 2 2018 的先例（见[日志](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/31)）。
